bio.text: Jackie Auringer, a Kingston native, announced her candidacy for New York's 18th Congressional District in April 2026, according to Spectrum News.
Spectrum News reported that she helps lead her family's construction business, Urban Precast.
Ballotpedia lists her as the Republican and Conservative Party candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election.

sources.title: Republican businesswoman Jackie Auringer enters race for NY-18 seat
